x: In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Commentary on Sūrat "Lam yakun" [al-Bayyina]
Discussion of the interpretation of the saying of God, glorified be His praise and hallowed be His names:

Those who disbelieved among the People of the Book and the polytheists were not going to depart until there came to them the Clear Proof (1) a Messenger from God, reciting purified scrolls (2) in which are upright writings (3) And those who were given the Book did not become divided until after the Clear Proof had come to them (4)
The people of interpretation differed about the interpretation of His saying:
Those who disbelieved among the People of the Book and the polytheists were not going to depart until there came to them the Clear Proof
Some of them said: its meaning is: these disbelievers among the people of the Torah and the Gospel, and the polytheists among the worshippers of idols, were not
, he says: desisting, until this Qurʾān came to them.
The people of interpretation said the same as we have said.

He, exalted be His mention, says: God did not command these Jews and Christians, who are the People of the Book, except to worship God,
being sincere to Him in religion

. He says: devoting obedience to Him alone, not mixing their obedience to their Lord with association. Yet the Jews associated others with their Lord by their saying that ʿUzayr is the son of God, and the Christians by their saying the same about the Messiah, and by their denial of the prophethood of Muḥammad ﷺ.

Their reward with their Lord is gardens of Eden beneath which rivers flow, abiding therein forever. God is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him. That is for whoever fears his Lord (8)

notes.en: In al-Farraʾ’s Maʿani al-Qurʾan (3/282), the wording is “bi-fihi.” It is a curse directed at a person: “May dust be in his mouth, fever of Khaybar, and an evil thing to see—he is a loser.” See Lisan al-ʿArab, root b-r-y.
notes.ar: في معاني القرآن للفراء 3/ 282: "بفيه". وهو دعاء على الإنسان، تقول: بفيه البرى، وحمّى خيبرا، وشرٌّ ما يُرى، فإنه خيسرى. اللسان (ب رى).

notes.en: Ibn ʿAdi transmitted it in al-Kamil (1/174), and Ibn ʿAsakir in Tarikh Dimashq (42/371), as a raised report from Abu Saʿid al-Khudri, with the wording “upon the best of creation.” Ibn Hajar said in Lisan al-Mizan (1/175): “This is a fabrication.”
notes.ar: أخرجه ابن عدى في الكامل 1/ 174، وابن عساكر في تاريخ دمشق 42/ 371 من حديث أبي سعيد الخدرى مرفوعًا بلفظ: "على خير البرية". قال ابن حجر في لسان الميزان 1/ 175: وهذا كذب.
